title: Ba$_{5}$(Ir,Ru)$_{3}$O$_{12}$ [Ba$_{5}$IrRu$_{2}$O$_{12}$] Structure
comments:
The iridium and ruthenium sites atoms are alloyed on three sites: \begin{itemize} \item The Ir I site is Ir$_{0.825}$Ru$_{0.175}$ \item The Ru I site is Ir$_{0.350}$Ru$_{0.650}$ \item The Ru II site is Ir$_{0.325}$Ru$_{0.675}$. \end{itemize} ~ \vspace{-.25in} 
 This gives the nominal composition Ba$_{5}$Ir$_{1.5}$Ru$_{1.5}$O$_{12}$. For purposes of illustration and labeling we fill each Wyckoff position with the dominant species.
